title: Let the True Shabad become your sign
summary: When the One is known within and around you, the Guru's Word is no longer only studied. It becomes the sign you carry into the Lord's court.
takeaway: Let the Shabad make the One visible inside and around you.
lifeApplication: When fear narrows the room, pause before the next reply and ask: can I recognize the same One within me and before me here? Let that recognition choose your tone.

source.shortMeaning: Knowing the One inwardly and outwardly, the seeker recognizes the self through the Guru's Shabad and bears Truth's sign in the Lord's court.
source.lifeApplication: Let one moment of recognition change how you stand before the person or task in front of you.

evidence.coreClaim: Knowing the One inwardly and outwardly, the seeker recognizes the self through the Guru's Shabad and bears Truth's sign in the Lord's court.
evidence.turn: The cited lines move from seeing the One everywhere to self-recognition through the Guru's Shabad and a life marked by Truth.
evidence.practicalImplication: When fear narrows the room, pause before the next reply and ask: can I recognize the same One within me and before me here? Let that recognition choose your tone.
